guides/store-private-documents-android.title: Private documents on Android
guides/store-private-documents-android.description: Locate every copy of a document first, then keep it in an encrypted vault with a checked backup, storing the backup and its secret apart from the phone.

guides/hidden-folder-vs-encrypted-vault.title: Hidden folder or encrypted vault?
guides/hidden-folder-vs-encrypted-vault.description: A hidden folder only changes what is visible, while an encrypted vault protects stored files with a secret. Check what is encrypted and how backups work.

guides/backup-offline-vault.title: How to back up an offline vault
guides/backup-offline-vault.description: Offline does not mean backed up. Create an encrypted backup in Settings, wait for the read-back check, and keep it away from the phone with its secret.

guides/before-deleting-originals.title: Check the copy before deleting the original
guides/before-deleting-originals.description: Before you delete an original, check the imported copy and make a checked encrypted backup, because deletion is not guaranteed secure erasure.

guides/recovery-key-vs-backup.title: Recovery key or backup?
guides/recovery-key-vs-backup.description: A recovery key unlocks the vault but is not a copy of your data. A backup holds the data and still needs a valid secret to open it.

guides/vault-without-account.title: What does a vault without an account mean?
guides/vault-without-account.description: With no account there is no reset link, so you keep your own recovery key and encrypted backups. The public app has no server and no internet permission.

guides/private-photos-android.title: How to keep private photos on Android
guides/private-photos-android.description: A hidden album may not encrypt photos, while an encrypted vault protects them with a secret. Check every copy first, then practise restoring sample photos.

guides/restore-nullkey-backup-new-phone.title: Restore a NullKey backup on a new phone
guides/restore-nullkey-backup-new-phone.description: Make a checked backup on the old phone, restore it into the new phone's empty vault and keep the old app until the restored vault is checked.

guides.title: Android privacy & backup guides
guides.description: Explore practical guides to private photos and documents, encrypted vaults, recovery keys and backups you can check and restore.
